notes:
It reads the small print now.

Some sites serve pages small enough that the lettering is only about ten pixels tall — too small for the text reader, which was quietly skipping whole lines in the middle of a balloon. You'd hear a narrator drop a beat and carry on, with nothing to tell you a line had gone missing.

On a Tales of Demons and Gods page, "come in five different ranks. These" and "demons they capture into their soul seas." were both never read at all. They are now — about 15% more of that chapter's words.

Pages like that are enlarged before being read. Webtoons are unaffected; they were already handled.

Chapters you've already read will re-read their pages once to pick this up.
